assessment_objectives.objective: chain of custody for logs, telemetry and evidence collected by Control Assurance Automation (CAA) is documented from source to repository, including the collecting mechanism, the source and the time of collection.

the integrity of logs, telemetry and evidence collected by Control Assurance Automation (CAA) is verified upon transfer from source to repository (e.g., hash comparison, record counts or digital signatures) and transfer failures or mismatches are recorded and investigated.

logs, telemetry and evidence collected by Control Assurance Automation (CAA) are stored in tamper-evident storage (e.g., cryptographic hashing, append-only or immutable storage) that allows unauthorized modification or deletion to be detected.
access to the Control Assurance Automation (CAA) evidence repository is restricted to authorized personnel and access and modification attempts are logged.
integrity verification records for Control Assurance Automation (CAA) evidence are retained for as long as the evidence itself is retained.
